it: \bTi auguro tutta la fortuna del mondo.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your first match.\nYour next battle will be on to the right.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your first match.\nYour next battle will be on to the right.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il tuo primo incontro.\nLa tua prossima lotta si terrà sulla destra.

id: \bThe best of luck to you... is what I would say if you weren't the Monarch.
en: \bThe best of luck to you... is what I would say if you weren't the Monarch.
it: \bTi augurerei buona fortuna... se non fossi il Monarca.
\bA quanto pare la fortuna serviva a te.
